_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the Yubei product catalog. Consumed by build-products.js to generate the /products page.

status_values.ok: Verified: model + size match the printed image.
status_values.corrected: A confirmed correction was applied (see notes).
status_values.need_confirmation: Uncertain — no reliable code/size on the image. NOT guessed. Awaiting confirmation.

field_notes.model: Real product code as printed on the image. 'xxxxx' = unknown, needs confirmation (never null).
field_notes.slug: URL-safe id derived from model (for future /products/<slug>). 'xxxxx' when model unknown.
field_notes.sizeRange: One accurate size. 'xxxxx' = unknown, needs confirmation (never null).
field_notes.name/category/colors: Descriptive metadata from the photo (safe, not identifiers).

display_rules: The literal value 'xxxxx' is an internal placeholder for unconfirmed data. It MUST NEVER be rendered on any customer-facing page.
Products with status 'need_confirmation' MAY remain in the database and MAY be shown, but any field whose value is 'xxxxx' must be hidden (omit that row/label) on public pages until confirmed.
Products carrying third-party brand logos are flagged in notes ('IP review') and must NOT be promoted publicly until reviewed.
Phase A generator rule: a product is PUBLIC only if status is ok/corrected, model and sizeRange are not 'xxxxx', and notes do not contain 'IP review'.
